contract.non_linear: No-op for supported method; invalid method raises ValueError before module type check; use model.apply for recursion
contract.mutation: In-place normal_ and bias.zero_ under torch.no_grad(); preserve Parameter and storage identity

statistical_tolerance: mean: 6*expected_std/sqrt(N); sample std (correction=1): 6*expected_std/sqrt(2*(N-1)), approximate six-standard-error bound. Small N=64 deliberately has wider tolerance. Additional matched-draw scaling tests check formulas without sampling uncertainty.
